checkpoints_not_frozen.why: written by the same run but NEVER evaluated -- 'best' under a different criterion, plus last/final. Excluded so no one can score one later and report it as this arm's result.

deliberate_deviations: Retrained from scratch on OUR data: 6,983-gene frozen axis, our 611-perturbation cohort, our 5 splits. Does NOT reproduce CellFlow's published 0.44015 (2,000 genes / 380 perturbations / 4 cell lines).

C3 CORRECTION, and it is load-bearing: the selection metric originally decoded BOTH the prediction and the ground truth through the rank-256 PCA basis, which removes everything the basis cannot express and inflated every component. It reported pearson_delta 0.4027 / overlap_at_N 0.908. Scored against untouched gene-space targets the same model gets 0.2449 validation / 0.2154 test -- the inflated figure was ~0.19 too high and would have ranked CellFlow first on the panel. The checkpoint frozen here was selected under the CORRECTED metric.

C4: n_conditions_on_log_iteration raised from 60 to the full 103 validation perturbations. ValidationSampler draws a fresh rng.choice each pass, so with 60 the successive selection scores were not comparable to each other.

C1/C2 export fixes: predict() requires adata.obs[control_key].all() to be True (we had set is_control all False, which raised); and the prediction block carried no uns, so rep_dict['gene_embeddings'] raised KeyError. Before these the export had never emitted a single row.

PCA basis is fit on TRAINING DATA ONLY (verified: centered_pca on adata_train alone, everything else projected through it, export uses the saved artifacts). ⚠️ It uses scanpy's random_state=0, so it does NOT vary with model.seed -- all seeds would share one representation.

C5/C6 hygiene: the one-hot condition vocabulary was built twice at different widths and only worked because control injection overwrote the validation uns with the training one; and a PYTHONHASHSEED-randomised abs(hash(...)) was replaced with a stable sha256.

⚠️ PROVENANCE GAP: the official recipe is not in this checkout. n_comps=256 is not a library default (50 is), and pooling, cond_output_dropout, time_encoder_dims, probability_path, linear_projection_before_concatenation and valid_freq all differ from library defaults with no traceable source. Two disclosed edits to the vendored package forward the seed.
freeze_note: artifacts/CellFlow.pkl was a duplicate of checkpoints/CellFlow.pkl (same bytes) caused by the artifacts *.pkl glob also matching the selected checkpoint. Removed; the script now excludes it.
